Frequently Asked Questions

What makes a top interior design firm in Hauz Khas worth hiring?

Strong design ideas, detailed drawings, reliable vendors and regular site supervision, so the finished space looks like the design you approved.

Do you work on both homes and commercial spaces?

Yes. We design homes, offices, salons, cafés and showrooms, and each project gets a design built around its own use.

How do you keep clients updated during the project?

We share progress at each stage, review samples with you and keep one point of contact for questions.

Is a top interior design firm only for large budgets?

No. Good planning helps any budget go further. We suggest where to spend and where to save so the result still feels complete.
